v0.9.86 broad Galenic shifts introduced new tributary/choroidal artery collisions; 2 mm shaft and broad falx-body fields failed quality/regression gates. Only the limited 1.5 mm shaft/inferior-edge field is retained.

G02.conclusion: All 12 original crossing corrections remain free of triangle intersections in the delivered geometry. Sampled APMV sections at Z=70 and 75 mm are posterior to the basilar artery, consistent with cited anatomical relationship. This is not whole-course or whole-atlas anatomical certification. Tiny sampled clearances should not be interpreted as physiological measurements.

G05.conclusion: Historical G05 is not resolved by the later generic callosal-repair note. Both A2–A5 chains retain matching seam coordinates but all eight segments contact registered brain surfaces. Left A5 also intersects the corpus-callosum surface. A3 remains separated from the registered callosal surface. Retain the issue, extend review to A5, and require coordinated vessel/brain registration and junction review. Do not repeat the previously rejected local displacement trial.
